C08-M03-L08-F1.title: The SIEM lab route: from loaded data to preserved evidence
C08-M03-L08-F1.caption: The seven stages of the lab, each exercising one SIEM capability from Lessons 1-7, in the order an analyst uses them during an investigation.
C08-M03-L08-F1.alt: Top-to-bottom flow of seven steps. Load and orient: minisiem.py load; counts by source, time range. Run saved rules: R1-R6, six detections. Pivot on an alert: VPN spray, src_ip 203.0.113.66. Write rule R7: download then Office spawn within 10 min. Build host timeline: WS-104, 06:00Z-09:00Z. Dashboard panels: hourly by source; top talkers. Export evidence: SHA-256 plus custody record, shown in dark as the final outcome.

steps.label: Load and orient
steps.sub: minisiem.py load; counts by source, time range

steps.label: Write rule R7

C08-M03-L08-F1.note: Every step queries the same events table; only the last one produces something that outlives retention.

C08-M03-L08-F2.title: Translating the lab: minisiem, Wazuh and Elastic
C08-M03-L08-F2.caption: Where each stage of the minisiem lab lives in a self-hosted Wazuh or Elastic single-node lab.
C08-M03-L08-F2.alt: Table with columns Stage, minisiem, Wazuh, Elastic. Collect: load from JSONL; Wazuh agent; Elastic Agent or Beats. Parse + normalise: kit fields, raw kept; decoders; ingest pipelines, ECS. Store + index: SQLite events table; Wazuh indexer, alerts by default; Elasticsearch indices, all events. Search: search with SQL; Wazuh dashboard; Kibana Discover. Detect: RULES dictionary; rules, levels 0-15; detection rules: query, threshold, EQL. Dashboards: GROUP BY queries; Wazuh dashboard; Kibana dashboards. Retention: purge on a copy; index management policies; ILM phases. Evidence: evidence_export.py; export events, hash, custody; export events, hash, custody.
C08-M03-L08-F2.note: Same stages, different products: the orange row is the main conceptual difference.
